Dimon flagged geopolitics and fiscal deficits as systemic risks in his own shareholder letter. 5. CONCLUSION: Regime conflict (macro risk-off vs daily chart still bullish structural), intraday distribution signals, prior regime basis falsified, and hourly price testing the stop zone.
